items.q: No, Margo was a graduate of the University of Vienna

ctx.x: No, Margo was a graduate of the University of Vienna and she spoke Viennese quite beautifully,

and English, and she was kind of a, I am sorry to say a snob. She wanted servants which we had in Chile and I hated the idea. with them. You know, I wanted to be friends. I just couldn't order them around. I never liked that idea, having servants, and then well, I began to realize that I should get back and get back to and get into music the States, get back to New York -- I was offered a job. We stayed in a hotel called the El Carrera and there was a room a very nice little room in the hotel, [inaudible] it was…
